test_run_simulation: test the TORAX simulation by running it and comparing results against reference output files
build_torax_config: build a ToraxConfig object from a Python config file using the config loader
check_profiles_vs_expected: check simulation profile outputs against expected reference values with configurable tolerances
get_torax_config: get a ToraxConfig instance from a config module file in the test data directory
get_refs: get reference profile data and time arrays from a saved NetCDF state file
